baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two singular imperatives, قُمْ and فَأَنذِرْ, are joined by فَ, making warning the immediate work of the rising.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bodily rising expands into resolve to undertake a matter, while warning is an alarm that awakens caution; the clause moves its addressee from rest into purposeful alerting action.

activation_trace.role: Upright bodily rising supplies the clause's initial physical transition out of rest.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter turns posture into committed action.
Warning that awakens fear and caution gives the undertaken action its alerting purpose.

changed_reading.before: Stand up, then deliver a warning.
changed_reading.after: Mobilize yourself with resolve, and make that rising immediately operative as an alarm that awakens caution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُمْ can denote taking charge of or standing over an affair, and أَنذِرْ supplies the protective warning performed within that charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: Standing is sustained guardianship rather than a momentary posture; warning becomes care that watches over others by making danger perceptible.

activation_trace.role: Care, guardianship, and preservation make the rising an assumption of sustained responsibility.
Fear-awakening warning functions as the protective act of that guardianship.

changed_reading.after: Take up watchful responsibility for people by continually making danger recognizable to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The undertaking branch of ق و م can meet the self-binding vow branch of ن ذ ر without leaving the two imperative forms.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command is heard as assuming an office whose warning task binds the addressee, not merely as producing an isolated utterance.

activation_trace.role: Resolve to undertake an affair supplies the voluntary taking-up of a charge.
Binding oneself to a non-obligatory vow supplies the charge's obligation-like force.

changed_reading.before: Warn because you have been told to warn.
changed_reading.after: Rise into a warning charge that now binds the one who undertakes it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The resurrection branch of ق و م and the danger-awakening branch of ن ذ ر coexist directly in قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger's singular rising can prefigure the collective rising about which he warns, making his action a small enactment of the warned event.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and the rising of the Hour supply an eschatological horizon within the command to rise.
The caution-awakening alarm makes the enacted rising point toward feared future danger.

changed_reading.before: Rise in order to speak about a future danger.
changed_reading.after: Rise now as an anticipatory enactment of the rising that your warning makes urgent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding address names an enveloped or covered person; the next command's rising therefore becomes emergence from a covered state into exposed public agency, with warning as the purpose of that emergence.

activation_trace.role: Bodily rising provides the movement out of the prior state.
Undertaking a matter converts emergence into a public commission.
The warning alarm supplies the outward task for which the addressee emerges.
A covering worn over the inner garment supplies the enclosed state from which the rising departs.

structural_cues: The vocative of 74:1 is followed immediately by the two terse imperatives of 74:2.
The فَ before أَنذِرْ makes warning follow directly from the commanded rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an enveloping garment image followed by rising and warning; I infer a directional passage from enclosure to public agency. A live alternative is that the epithet merely identifies the addressee and does not describe a state being left.

changed_reading.before: Get up from a resting posture and warn.
changed_reading.after: Come out from enveloped privacy into an exposed commission, and make that emergence serve warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning office is immediately unfolded as Lord-oriented formation: magnifying, cleansing the garment or self, separating from disturbance, and enduring. Warning is thus maintained through the warners' own ordered condition, not exhausted by speech.

activation_trace.role: Guardianship and preservation make standing a maintained office.
Caution-awakening warning is the public function of the maintained office.
Repair, cultivation, and completion frame the commission as formative work under the Lord.
Garment and its figurative relation to the self give the warning office an embodied surface.
Purifying self and action from ugliness makes integrity part of how warning is borne.
Separation and severance supply a boundary against what would compromise the office.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the endurance needed to sustain warning.

structural_cues: 74:2-7 form a compact run of commands centered on the same singular addressee.
The repeated فَ-imperatives bind magnifying, purifying, separating, and enduring to the initial rise-and-warn commission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a command sequence and branches of cultivation, self-purification, separation, and restraint; I infer that these are operating disciplines of the warning office. A live alternative is to read them as adjacent duties without a shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Stand and transmit a verbal warning.
changed_reading.after: Assume a durable protective office whose warning is carried by disciplined self-ordering, separation, and endurance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later struck signal and severe event-day give the focus rising an acoustic and temporal horizon: the one who rises to warn now rehearses the response demanded when the decisive summons sounds.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and rising of the Hour let the singular command anticipate a larger rising.
The fear-awakening alarm connects present action to future danger.
A rapid striking sound supplies the later summons that the present warning anticipates.
The event-day and its severity give the warning a bounded moment of realization.

structural_cues: The initial command sequence yields at 74:8 to فَإِذَا, a temporal transition into the struck signal.
The doubled نُقِرَ/ٱلنَّاقُورِ occurrence intensifies the sounding event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a resurrection branch for rising, an alarm branch for warning, and a later struck signal on a severe day; I infer that the first rising models readiness for the later summons. A live alternative is that قُمْ remains only immediate bodily mobilization.

changed_reading.before: Rise now to report a later event.
changed_reading.after: Rise now in rehearsal of the response that the later struck summons will demand, and awaken others to that readiness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning becomes a diagnostic stimulus rather than guaranteed persuasion: the same presented sign tests its hearers, settles some into certainty, leaves others in disturbed doubt, and discloses who advances or delays.

activation_trace.role: Resolute undertaking supplies the issuer's action without presuming control of reception.
An alarm that awakens caution supplies the common signal presented to hearers.
Testing metal or a person supplies the signal's discriminating action.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies one possible reception.
Agitated doubt supplies the contrasting reception exposed by the same stimulus.
Advancing forward gives responsive movement its positive direction.
Delay to a later time gives the alternative response its withholding direction.

structural_cues: 74:31 explicitly coordinates divergent effects of one numbered sign.
74:37 restates response as the paired motion يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, certainty, doubt, advance, and delay around one communicated sign; I infer that warning functions causally as a diagnostic exposure of response. A live alternative is that these effects belong only to the later numerical sign and should not be generalized to the opening warning.

changed_reading.before: Warn in order to make everyone accept the danger.
changed_reading.after: Issue the warning faithfully as a test-signal that makes each hearer's direction visible, whether toward certainty or disturbed delay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is recast as disclosure: a mark appears on the human surface, night withdraws, dawn removes covering, and the warning is then named for humanity. Warning does not only state danger; it brings a previously obscured condition into visibility.

activation_trace.role: Rising supplies the warners' own transition into visible action.
The caution-awakening alarm is the focus act later reframed as disclosure.
Visible skin or surface supplies the human plane on which consequence becomes apparent.
Flashing appearance supplies the emergence of a formerly unseen mark.
Removing a covering supplies dawn's revelatory action and the model's disclosure mechanism.
The repeated warning branch identifies the disclosed major sign as an alarm directed to humanity.

structural_cues: 74:29 places visible effect on ٱلْبَشَرِ before the night-and-dawn oath sequence of 74:32-34.
74:36 repeats the focus root as the nominal نَذِيرًا and again directs it to ٱلْبَشَرِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surface appearance, removal of covering at dawn, and a repeated warning to humanity; I infer that visibility is a function of warning. A live alternative is that these are separate descriptions of the warned object rather than of how warning operates.

changed_reading.before: Rise and tell people that danger exists.
changed_reading.after: Rise and warn by bringing hidden consequence into view on the human plane.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later confession gives the opening warning practical content: failure consists in absent worship, absent feeding, immersion in a group's discourse, and denial of reckoning. Rising to warn therefore calls for an embodied counter-pattern, not bare threat transmission.

activation_trace.role: Standing as care and preservation makes warning answerable to concrete human conduct.
The caution-awakening alarm frames the later failures as preventable trajectories.
Specified worship supplies one omitted practice named by those who ignored the warning.
Feeding another supplies the social practice whose omission has consequence.
Entering deeply into talk or an affair supplies the collective current that carries participants away.
Attributing falsehood supplies the explicit rejection that sustains the harmful pattern.
Accounting and recompense supply the horizon denied by the hearers.

structural_cues: 74:42 asks what path brought the speakers into Saqar, and 74:43-46 answer with four coordinated first-person failures.
The repeated وَكُنَّا and negated نَكُ turn isolated acts into an accumulated way of being.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a retrospective causal list of omitted and adopted practices; I infer that the opening warning prospectively calls hearers into the opposite pattern. A live alternative is that the list only diagnoses condemnation and does not define the warning's positive content.

changed_reading.after: Intervene against a lived trajectory by calling people toward worship and feeding, out of collective empty immersion and denial of account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is later named a reminder, while refusal is pictured as turning one's side away. The mechanism shifts from inserting unknown information to re-presenting what can be recalled and demanding a bodily or volitional reorientation toward it.

activation_trace.role: Resolved undertaking supplies the warners' repeated presentation of the reminder.
The alarm awakens caution, making warning an act of reactivation rather than neutral information.
A reminder that causes remembering supplies the later functional name for the warning.
Turning one's side away gives failed reception a spatial posture opposite to engaged standing.

structural_cues: 74:49 juxtaposes ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ and مُعْرِضِينَ in one question.
74:54-56 repeat تَذْكِرَةٌ, ذَكَرَهُ, and يَذْكُرُونَ, extending warning into a sustained remembering sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reminder language and a branch of bodily turning-away; I infer that warning seeks cognitive reactivation through reorientation. A live alternative is that reminder and warning are complementary but functionally distinct speech acts.

changed_reading.before: Give hearers new information about danger.
changed_reading.after: Stand forth to reactivate caution already available to remembrance, confronting the hearers' chosen posture of turning aside.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This legal-economic reading is surprising because the focus verb is morphologically the warning form, not the vow noun; it remains anchored through the packet's vow branch for ن ذ ر, undertaking branch for ق و م, and later earning, pledge, and account branches. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory obligation metaphor, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُمْ supplies assuming an undertaking and أَنذِرْ carries a root branch of self-binding obligation alongside its direct warning sense.

activation_trace.role: Undertaking a matter supplies assumption of the warning office.
Self-binding vow supplies the exploratory obligation register within the warning root.
Acquiring gain supplies the deeds or proceeds entered into liability.
Collateral held against a right supplies the later image of each self under claim.
Accounting and recompense complete the liability horizon to which warning gives notice.

changed_reading.after: Assume a binding warning office and serve notice that every self's acquisitions stand held for account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The obstructive-cover to protective-cover arc is surprising because it links distant branch images across the surah; it remains anchored in the focus movement from rising to warning and in exact covering, uncovering, and preserving branches. Downstream prose should label the directional arc as reader-supplied and retain it only as a symbolic mechanism, not a lexical paraphrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُمْ initiates movement out of a prior covered state, and أَنذِرْ supplies the alarm whose work can be read against later concealment and disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Bodily rising supplies departure from an enclosed posture.
Caution-awakening warning supplies the transforming intervention between concealment and safety.
The outer covering supplies the arc's initial enclosure.
Covering and concealment supply the obstructive form of enclosure addressed by warning.
Removing a cover supplies the disclosure phase of the transformation.
A covering that preserves supplies the protective rather than obstructive endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Leave covering behind so that danger can be announced.
changed_reading.after: Rise through obstructive covering, warn by uncovering what it hides, and orient the exposed hearer toward a covering that preserves.

strongest_changes: The immediate context turns a posture command into emergence from enclosure and assumption of a sustained warning office.
The struck signal and severe day make the focus rising an anticipatory rehearsal of the response demanded by the final summons.
The later test, certainty, doubt, advance, and delay sequence recasts warning as a diagnostic signal that reveals direction rather than coercing assent.
The confession in 74:43-46 gives warning embodied ethical content, while 74:49-56 reframes its cognitive work as reactivation of remembrance.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus clause is unusually branch-dense: ق و م contributes posture, undertaking, guardianship, and resurrection, while ن ذ ر contributes alarm and, more distantly, self-binding obligation. The surrounding surah repeatedly converts those latent possibilities into spatial, temporal, ethical, cognitive, and legal mechanisms without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The resurrection rehearsal depends on activating a broad nominal branch of ق و م inside an immediate singular imperative.
The practical failures of 74:43-46 may specify the warning's content, or they may only narrate the consequences of refusing it.
The visibility and covering arcs are coherent across exact branches, but their directional causality is reader-supplied rather than explicit grammar.
The vow-liability model is worth preserving as an outlier but is too form-distant to control translation.
